751-4068-6006.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
751-4068-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2411-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-5434.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Quicksilver Gargantuan each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

4091-7066-7791.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Avatar Kyoshi.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

108-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eyeless Watcher, adding {C}{C}.
When Eyeless Watcher dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Eyeless Watcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Eyeless Watcher enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

513-1742-6896.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland permanent card in hand that costs {2} or less.
You control a nontoken nonland permanent that costs {2} or less.
513-1742-6896.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a nonland permanent card that costs {2} or less.
Cast the permanent from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {0} due to Green Goblin.
Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another nonland permaennt that costs 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

64-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Warden of the Eye
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Warden of the Eye
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4476-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4476-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

5414-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

774-3478-6664.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Dimir Aqueduct's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2279-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3317-4050-6290.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional creature.
3317-4050-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Lightwheel Enhancements enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightwheel Enhancements attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

147-5231-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5231-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5231-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

851-1563-2457-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3967-5434-5555-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
3967-5434-5555-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Yahenni by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-2292-4053-6989.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-2018-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have flying.
997-2018-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with a flying counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-3263-4853-6797.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

527-2178-5256-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 2 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
527-2178-5256-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Selvala trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Selvala.
Resolve the Selvala trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

560-2558-4779-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

527-542-4785.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-4785.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-710-2843.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2061-2104-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2061-2104-4823.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1879-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1879-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

575-1794-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper, adding {C}{C}.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Ruthless Ripper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
When Ruthless Ripper is turned face up, it triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

2584-3059-4847.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2034-3374-4801.notablePrerequisites: Phantom Flock does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-3374-4801.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Phantom Flock persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantom Flock, adding {C}{C}.
When Phantom Flock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with two +1/+1 counters on it due to its first ability.
Repeat.

364-1987-2556.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
364-1987-2556.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mnemonic Wall and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
